I have a little experience of exchanging old gold ornaments for new ones. I have found that P.C. Chandra Jewellers gives a fair deal on gold exchange. I have exchanged non-hallmarked 91.6% pure gold in this showroom and received the complete exchange value for gold. There was no deduction in the weight of gold or the cost per gram of gold during the aforementioned exchange. Some of the other big gold brands in the city were not willing to offer such a deal. I have also exchanged 75% and 78% pure gold which correspond to 18K and a little above 18K purity, from this showroom. There was a deduction, perhaps slightly on the higher side, in the weight of gold as there should be since the calculation is based on the price of 91.6% pure gold. If one takes into account the price of 18K gold on the day, it was again a fair deal. In the first instance, the old ornaments were cut into smaller pieces to ascertain the purity of gold possibly by using a Karat meter while in the second case, the visibly less pure gold ornaments were first melted and solidified and then the purity of gold was checked. The process is quite transparent. I felt that the designs of gold ornaments were exquisite. The making charge of gold ornaments was 18% of the value of gold. The salespersons were courteous, I am quite happy with my experience in this showroom.

Whether it’s lightweight daily wear pieces or heavy traditional jewellery, their designs are stunning and diverse. While custom orders may take up to a month or more, they are always worth the wait. Everything is hallmarked and meets the highest quality standards, which makes PCC Gold a trusted name in our family.

Their customer service is top-notch, with knowledgeable, well-trained staff who handle every transaction with care and professionalism. I’ve never faced any billing errors or confusion, and the security arrangements are excellent, offering complete peace of mind even when carrying personal gold for exchange or evaluation.

What I also love is how they make customers feel valued -invitations to events, exclusive previews, and a genuine sense of connection. P.C. Chandra is more than a brand - it’s a legacy of trust and excellence.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality, integrity, and elegance in their jewellery shopping experience!

On October 27th, 2024, we visited the newly opened PC Chandra showroom on Tobin Road, conveniently located near our home. The ambiance was impressive, with a warm and inviting atmosphere. The staff was exceptionally polite and attentive, especially the sales associates, who did their best to showcase a variety of ornaments despite the crowd during the Dhanteras festival. However, the stock of ornaments seemed somewhat limited, possibly due to high purchase volumes for the occasion.

We purchased a few pieces of jewelry and were delighted to receive a 22 Karat 200 mg gold coin as a gift. The showroom also offers parking facilities, which added to the convenience of our shopping experience. Overall, it was a pleasant visit with excellent service and a thoughtfully designed setup for customers.

The P.C. Chandra Jewellers store on Tobin Road looks grand and inviting! The building’s architecture has a classic charm with a clock tower on the side, creating an eye-catching display, especially at night with all the beautiful lighting. Founded in 1939, this jeweller has a legacy, and the store’s design reflects that heritage and prestige. It's definitely a landmark in the area and adds a touch of elegance to the neighborhood.
